risk_reasons: Issue #665 changes the fail-closed detector that decides whether destructive account purge may be marked complete when physical postal-address PII survives.
Issue #662 intentionally extends an AAL2-gated admin query across tenants to resolve a correction actor from users; an incorrect scope or wire shape could expose identity data.
goal: After an admin takes the Correction path, the suppressions console shows one current Suppression ledger state with a readable correction actor, and account-offboarding verification detects any surviving Attested postal address tuple before purge completion.
non_goals: Change the write-side account purge or its 30-day lifecycle.
Add a schema migration, foreign key, or denormalized actor snapshot to correction records.
Redesign the admin suppressions console or remediate its pre-existing palette and layout.
Change Correction path authorization, atomicity, no-re-subscribe framing, or logging posture.
Commit, push, deploy, merge, or close either GitHub issue without separate authority.
user_visible_behavior: A successful or already-removed correction clears any stale manual-entry success/error receipt before the invalidated Suppression ledger query re-renders current state.
PRIOR CORRECTIONS displays the removing admin's name and email when the users row exists, and falls back to the raw UUID when it does not.
Purge verification reports a businesses violation when any of the five Attested postal address columns survives and reports none after the tuple is cleared.
invariants: The Correction path remains admin-only behind requireAdminWithAal2 and remains error correction, never re-subscribe.
The correction audit record retains a plain removed_by_user_id with no foreign key and remains valid after the user row is gone.
The suppression lookup remains a POST with the Normalized handle in the body and never logs or places the handle in a URL.
Cross-tenant reads remain explicit, read-only, allowlisted, and limited to the AAL2-gated admin servicing surface.
The businesses purge detector lists all five attestation columns even though the current database CHECK makes the tuple all-NULL or all-present.
A failed correction does not invalidate the query, drop the selected live row, or claim that the suppression was removed.
No account-offboarding purge write statement changes.
edge_cases: A deleted or otherwise missing users row renders the correction's removed_by_user_id rather than an empty actor cell.
Both corrected and already_removed are successful mutation outcomes and clear the stale entry receipt; a genuine correction failure leaves current UI state intact.
A previously attested address that the purge cleared yields zero businesses violations.
An artificially restored attestation tuple with google_place_address still NULL yields one businesses violation attributable to the new predicate.
